english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for money, including wealth in ordinary speech.
Use this as the all-purpose word when “cash” simply means money.
For everyday money in general, 錢 is the all-purpose choice.

examples.english: I don't have enough money to buy this phone.
examples.traditional: 我冇咁多錢買呢部電話。
